[[39 BBY]]{{WhenThrassMetThrawnDate}} and 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system|BBY]] {{C|flashbacks}}The flashbacks in ''Chaos Rising'' occur prior to that novel's main events, which are set in [[19 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''. |series=''[[Star Wars: The Ascendancy Trilogy]]'' |preceded by= |followed by=[[Thrawn Ascendancy: Greater Good|''Greater Good'']] }} '''''Thrawn Ascendancy: Chaos Rising''''' is a [[canon]] novel written by [[Timothy Zahn]], and it is the first volume of ''[[Star Wars: The Ascendancy Trilogy]]''. It was first published in hardcover by [[Del Rey]] on [[September 1]], [[2020]], along with its [[Thrawn Ascendancy: Chaos Rising (audiobook)|audiobook adaptation]]. The novel is set prior to Zahn's previous ''[[Star Wars: The Imperial Trilogy]]'', and it explores the origins of [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] within the [[Chiss Ascendancy]]. Some events in the book are parallel to the flashback part of ''[[Thrawn: Alliances]]''. {{TOClimit|2}}
